description: Zoe Martinez walks into the Millfield Community Center in person and asks for Lisa Freeman. She explains she is unemployed with zero savings and $2,404 in monthly expenses. She asks about emergency assistance programs, hardship funds, food support, and utility assistance. She also asks about the status of the $2,500 retraining grant she applied for in tick 2, whether the new 10% threshold policy applies to service sector workers, and when Kevin O'Brien holds financial office hours. She is not emailing. She is standing at the front desk, scared and asking directly.

resources_exchanged.information: Zoe's situation: unemployed, zero savings, 22 years old, 22% through Google Digital Marketing certificate, gig work insufficient to cover expenses, grant application pending since tick 2

expected_outcome: Access to emergency hardship fund information, food pantry, utility assistance, grant status clarification, Kevin O'Brien office hours schedule

secondary_transaction.description: Zoe contacts Maria Santos's council office by phone to follow up on the retraining grant application submitted at tick 2. She asks specifically whether the newly lowered 10% threshold applies to her situation as a displaced service sector worker whose cafe hours were cut, and whether she needs to refile under the new criteria. She references her original application and asks for a status update.
secondary_transaction.expected_outcome: Grant status confirmation or reapplication path; $2,500 disbursement if approved under new threshold
